definition: [ יָרָא ] verb shoot, pour (Aramaic orthography of יָרָה q. v.) — Qal Infinitive construct לִירוֺא בַּחִצִּים 2Chr 26:15 shoot with arrows. Hiph`il Imperfect וַיֹּרא֯וּ 2Sam 11:24 and they shot at ( אֶלֿ ); Participle plural הַמּוֺרִא֯ים v 2Sam 11:24 the shooters, archers ; Kt to be read וַיֹּרִאוּ , הַמּוֺרַאִים ; but Masora nothing א as superfluous, would read וַיֹּרוּ , הַמּוֺרִים from יָרָה ( Bö § 1088 (8), (9)). Hoph`al Imperfect only in וּמַרְוֶה גַּם הוּא יוֺרֶ֑א Prov 11:25 he that watereth shall himself also be watered ( Fl De MV and others derive — 'non bene,' Thes — from √ רוה , q. v., יוֺרֶא for יָרְוֶה ֗֗֗ ; but see Thes Ew § 131 f. Bö § 161 (4) SS Buhl Kö i. 585 ; compare ירה 4 ).
